## Type of change
<!-- Put an x in one box -->
- [ ] 📇 New entry (a documented AI achievement)
- [ ] ✏️ Correction / update to an existing entry
- [ ] 🔧 Repo tooling / docs

## Entry details (for new entries)
- **Field:** <!-- e.g. mathematics, medicine, robotics -->
- **Folder path:** <!-- e.g. mathematics/my-new-entry/ -->
- **What the AI did, in one line:**

## Required parts checklist
<!-- Every new entry MUST have all three files and a citation. -->
- [ ] Created a folder under the correct field with a kebab-case slug
- [ ] `README.md` — has **Field:**, **When:**, `## What happened`, `## Why it matters`, `## Sources`
- [ ] `PROMPT.md` — how to recreate it (code/data/model links, or the actual prompt/method)
- [ ] `CONTEXT.md` — background + **honest caveats** (contested results, proof-of-concept, scope limits)
- [ ] **At least one primary or highly credible source** is cited (peer-reviewed paper, official release, or reputable reporting)
- [ ] Added a row for the entry to the field's index `README.md` table
- [ ] Updated counts/badges in the root `README.md` if needed

## Quality bar
- [ ] The claim is **documented and concrete** (not "AI is transforming X")
- [ ] It's **factual and hype-free**, and I noted caveats honestly
- [ ] I did **not** invent or overstate a result (if it's partial/contested, the entry says so)

## Validation
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_entries.py` locally and it passed ✅
